title: BLIK from a "friend"
text: Hi, it's Kasia. My card got blocked at the checkout and I need help urgently. Please send me the BLIK code from your banking app, I will pay you back tonight.

title: Parcel "extra fee"
text: InPost: your parcel is on hold. Pay the 1.99 PLN delivery fee within 24 hours or it will be returned. Enter your card number and CVV at https://inpost-pl.delivery-fee.top

title: "Bank" account blocked
text: PKO Bank: we have blocked your account because of suspicious activity. Log in now with your login and password at https://pko-verify-account.com to unlock it, otherwise your money will be lost.

title: Real parcel notice
text: InPost: your parcel is waiting in locker KRA01M until Friday. Pickup code: 482915.
